## IDockingService

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Components.Core`

### Purpose
Manages docked panel components in the UI. Allows kernel-aware components to be docked as panels with lifecycle management.

### Interface Definition

```csharp
public interface IDockingService
{
    public record DockRequest(Type Component, string Title, Action OnClose);
    IDisposable OnDockRequest(Action<DockRequest> callback);
    void Dock<TKernelComponent>(string title, Action onClose)
        where TKernelComponent : KernelComponentBase;
}
```

### Types

#### DockRequest
Record containing dock request information:

```csharp
public record DockRequest(Type Component, string Title, Action OnClose);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `Component` | `Type` | The component type to dock (must inherit from `KernelComponentBase`) |
| `Title` | `string` | Panel title |
| `OnClose` | `Action` | Callback invoked when the panel is closed |

### Methods

#### OnDockRequest(Action<DockRequest> callback)
Subscribes to dock request events. Returns `IDisposable` for unsubscription.

```csharp
IDisposable OnDockRequest(Action<DockRequest> callback);
```

#### Dock<TKernelComponent>(string title, Action onClose)
Requests docking of a `KernelComponentBase`-derived component.

```csharp
void Dock<TKernelComponent>(string title, Action onClose)
    where TKernelComponent : KernelComponentBase;
```

**Constraints:**
- `TKernelComponent` must inherit from `KernelComponentBase`
- The component receives the active `Kernel` instance automatically

### Usage Example

```csharp
public class MyDockedPanel : KernelComponentBase
{
    // Kernel is available as [Parameter]
}

// In a service or component:
public void OpenPanel(IDockingService docking)
{
    docking.Dock<MyDockedPanel>("My Panel", () => Console.WriteLine("Panel closed"));
}
```

### Related
- `KernelComponentBase` - Required base class for docked components
- `IWindowHandle` - Browser window lifecycle handle
